name: wrapper-location-zero-position-to-geojson
source: built by this program: vector 04's Wrapper with the wrapped Location's latitude and longitude both 0, which opendroneid.h defines as unknown: no position (gate if !<lat>:64 0). The geodetic altitude is still decoded, but GeoJSON holds hae only as the third coordinate of a Point (engine-spec, geojson slots), so with no point it is not written
